g.text: Three workload options from the same measurements

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d5660

g.text: Fixed 113.2B-quote dataset · 59-vCPU / 236-GiB service · 12 repeats at each core setting
Each option keeps its weights fixed across cores. Primary benchmark mix: D1/D2 once each; A1–A4 six times each.
Rates exclude idle gaps and use server execution time. CPU cores controls max_threads; physical service capacity stays fixed.
Warm data cache; result cache off. No smoothing, automatic retries or removed observations.
